# UQDA Core v0.1.6

This maintenance release adds a safe, cross-platform removal path and completes
Homebrew lifecycle management.

## Uninstall and reinstall

- Adds the official `uninstall.sh` for macOS, Linux, FreeBSD, OpenBSD,
  EdgeOS, and VyOS.
- Normal removal stops services and removes program files while preserving the
  configuration and cryptographic node identity for a later reinstall.
- Explicit `--purge` mode permanently removes configuration, identity,
  runtime state, and UQDA backups after confirmation.
- Adds `--dry-run` so administrators can review the removal plan first.
- Installs the uninstaller with macOS, Debian, router, and portable packages.
- Makes `brew uninstall --cask uqda/core/uqda` invoke the official removal
  path.
- Adds isolated safety tests for preservation, purge, confirmation, and
  dry-run behavior.

## Homebrew

The Cask is updated to version 0.1.6 and remains pinned to a release-specific,
SHA-256-verified installer.
